## Context / Problem
`AGENTS.md` says launch-loaded guidance must stay lean and point to maintained documentation, but its background-process section embeds a dated incident narrative, operator recovery procedure, and detector explanation. Every agent pays that context cost even when it only needs the prevention contract.

## Approach
- Replace the long `AGENTS.md` section with a compact, imperative prevention contract that retains the safety invariants, spawn-time bound and process-group cleanup example, explicit exemption for bounded LLM gate operations, and a pointer to detailed documentation.
- Move incident evidence, detector usage, false-positive interpretation, and operator recovery into `docs/orphaned-processes.md`; index it from `docs/README.md`.
- Update `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` so its user-facing recovery guidance names the canonical runbook, and cover that contract in `tests/scripts/test_check_orphaned_load.py`.
- Preserve commands and facts needed to prevent, detect, and reclaim orphaned processes. Do not copy unrelated tracker or implementation history.

## Scope
- `AGENTS.md`: compress the launch-loaded background-process rule.
- `docs/orphaned-processes.md`: own detailed incident evidence, prevention rationale, detector interpretation, and operator recovery.
- `docs/README.md`: index the operations page.
- `scripts/check_orphaned_load.py`: direct runtime users to the canonical runbook.
- `tests/scripts/test_check_orphaned_load.py`: assert the runtime runbook reference.

## Testing
- Run `python scripts/check_docs_index.py`.
- Run focused documentation and orphan-detector tests.
- Run `make lint` with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- Verify the moved commands and safety invariants remain reachable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `AGENTS.md` background-process section contains no more than 35 physical source lines.
- [ ] The compact section includes a wall-clock-bounded spawn plus process-group cleanup example.
- [ ] The compact section states that no spawned process may reach PPID 1 and that each subagent must reap its own helpers.
- [ ] The compact section prohibits unbounded busy loops without a wall-clock bound.
- [ ] The compact section explicitly forbids applying timeouts to bounded LLM gate operations.
- [ ] Dated incident evidence is absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [ ] Orphan-detector interpretation and operator reclamation steps are absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [ ] The Operations section of `docs/README.md` links `orphaned-processes.md` as the prevention, detection, and recovery procedure.
- [ ] The detailed page documents bounded spawn, process-group cleanup, read-only detection, and confirmed reclamation commands.
- [ ] Orphan-detector runtime guidance points to `docs/orphaned-processes.md`, with a regression test.
- [ ] Documentation checks and focused tests pass.
- [ ] `make lint` passes with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- [ ] Gerrit reports `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and no unresolved comments.
- [ ] The change is submitted to `main`.

## Verification
Compare the pre-change and post-change section line counts; search for every preserved invariant, command, and runbook reference; run the focused tests and lint; then confirm Gerrit labels and merged status before closing the ticket.
